name: Prototype 2 with all bonus and my extra features added
author: Xypess
description: Do not feed wolves and run away from them. Fire key is SPACE. You can hold it. Special ammo key is M which can feed animal with just one shot but you got limited. I added Vertical player movement, Aggressive animals, Game user interface, Animal hunger bar. extra I make spawn faster as time pass so the more hear us throwing food, the more animal coming to eat. Added ending screen and ui and collecting apples to increase lives.
